targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM api_request_metrics WHERE created_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '15 minutes'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM api_request_metrics WHERE status_code BETWEEN 400 AND 499 AND created_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '15 minutes'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM api_request_metrics WHERE status_code >= 500 AND created_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '15 minutes'
SELECT ROUND(AVG(duration_ms),2) AS value FROM api_request_metrics WHERE created_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '15 minutes'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM maintenance_requests GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS count FROM maintenance_requests GROUP BY priority ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at-created_at))/3600)::numeric,2) AS value FROM maintenance_requests WHERE status='done'

SELECT e.name, COUNT(r.id) AS requests, COUNT(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status='done') AS closed FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN maintenance_requests r ON r.equipment_id=e.id GROUP BY e.id,e.name ORDER BY requests DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM maintenance_requests WHERE planned_at < NOW() AND status IN ('new','in_progress')
